title: Settings fetch stages kept as paired loading bools and Option caches
trigger: n/a (stage held by hand)
effect: Each cleared only on its answer or error arm in error.rs/apply.rs; today all arms clear them.
fix: Fetch<T> per resource (storage_stats, account_ttl, connected_websites, default_auto_delete); one SettingsOp enum for the mutating ops. data_storage_error is also one slot shared by four requests.

title: Sessions list: sessions_mutating, sessions_stale, device_login_result beside Fetch
trigger: n/a
effect: sessions_mutating/websites_mutating/account_mutating are cleared in separate ok (session_apply_ok.rs) and error (error.rs) arms; stale flags drive refetch on ingest.
fix: An enum for the one mutation in flight (Idle, Terminating, Toggling, ...) and Fetch::stale for the refetch need.

title: Read-date privacy is read_date_show: Option<bool> + read_date_loading + read_date_error
trigger: Privacy screen: toggle 'show read time', fail, reopen.
effect: One loading flag serves both getReadDatePrivacy and setReadDatePrivacy; a get answer landing during a set clears loading and overwrites the optimistic value; the failure arm clears the value to None by hand.
fix: Fetch<bool> with a Saving(Option<RequestId>) sub-state, as for the other privacy rules.

title: Sticker set edits: pending counter + refresh_needed + deleted flags
trigger: n/a
effect: finish_sticker_set_edit decrements and sets refresh_needed; accept_sticker_set_view overwrites refresh_needed from busy().
fix: enum SetEditStage { Idle, InFlight(HashSet<RequestId>), NeedsRefresh, Deleted }.

title: Emoji panel: failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, pending_status_emoji, status_note
trigger: n/a
effect: One failed flag shared by three tab lists and the set mutation; error arm sets several fields by hand.
fix: Per-list Fetch and enum EmojiMutation { Idle, Changing(set), Failed }.

title: GIF panel: loading, loaded, failed, stale, search_loading, search_failed bools
trigger: n/a
effect: Error arms set failed/loaded together by hand (GetSavedAnimations sets loading=false, loaded=true, failed=true, stale=false).
fix: Fetch<Vec<Animation>> for saved and for search.

title: Emoji packs box stage is spread over failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, tab and emoji_set_return_tab
trigger: Any use of the box
effect: panel.failed and panel.mutation_failed are two bool failure flags beside mutating_set: Option<(i64,bool)>; the session tab must be kept in step by hand with PickerUi::emoji_set_return_tab and the search field; loading is derived from request purposes separately
fix: Per-list Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> for installed/trending/search and one enum Mutation {Idle, Changing{set,install}, Failed}; return tab derived from the last non-search view.

title: Stickers manager: open flag in the Session plus a commit queue stepped by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: open is set by the UI and cleared by finish_manager/farewell; commits advance only via advance_manager_commit after each answer.
fix: Move open to SettingsUi; model a commit as enum CommitStage { Removing(queue), Reordering, Done }.

title: Masks panel: open, failed, installed_loaded, archived_loaded, strip_wanted, confirm_remove
trigger: n/a
effect: finish_mask_mutation resets six fields by hand; fail_mask_request sets one shared failed.
fix: Fetch per list and an enum for the confirm box; open belongs to the screen, not the Session.

title: LiveStoryState::extras_requested bool marks that three extra requests were sent
trigger: The viewer sets it when asking streamer, top donors and senders; each answer fills streamer/donors/message_senders independently and errors do nothing (live.rs:402-405).
effect: A failed extras request is never retried while the story is open; the three Options and the flag are separate stages.
fix: Three Fetch<T> fields (or one LiveExtras enum) with Failed->retry.

title: ActiveStoriesPaging is exhausted: bool plus retry: Option, mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: failed() sets exhausted and clears retry on 404, otherwise sets retry; apply_stories_ok clears retry only.
effect: The two fields must never both be set; same for custom_emoji_retry plus custom_emoji_failures.
fix: enum Paging { Idle, Loading, Waiting{until,wait}, Exhausted }.

title: Custom emoji fetch retry is custom_emoji_retry Option plus custom_emoji_failures counter kept in step by hand
trigger: A getCustomEmojiStickers fetch fails, then a later one succeeds
effect: accept_story_custom_emoji_stickers clears retry but not failures, so the two disagree after the first failure; failures only grows
fix: One enum: Idle, Backoff{failures, until, delay}; success returns to Idle.

title: setCloseFriends is close_friends plus close_friends_pending applied on ok
trigger: Save close friends: pending ids are staged, ok moves them, error clears pending (error.rs:141-143).
effect: A dropped answer (generation change, sweep) leaves pending set with no owner.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> with a Saving{ids,request} stage.

title: Per-story fetch stage spread over story_retry, reply_attempted, missing and the stories map
trigger: story_fetch_failed removes reply_attempted and writes story_retry; the 400/404 arm inserts missing; success only inserts into stories.
effect: Three sets and a map encode Unasked/Asked/Waiting/Gone/Ready by hand.
fix: HashMap<(chat,story), StoryFetch> enum.

title: Direct messages topic loading is requested + exhausted sets; a failed first load is never asked again
trigger: maybe_preload_direct_topics inserts requested when the first send succeeded; a non-404 error only sets chat_action_error (threads/error.rs:55).
effect: The first page failing leaves requested set, so the preload never retries; only a scroll to the tabs end calls load_more.
fix: Per-chat enum Idle/Loading/Ready/Exhausted/Failed; clear Asked on error.

title: Forum topic list stage is forum_topics + forum_row_asked + forum_topics_failed + topic_load_failed
trigger: forum_row_asked is inserted when the send succeeded, forum_topics_failed on error (never retried: 'rows show No chats and do not ask again'), forum_topics on success removes failed.
effect: Three collections encode Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed per chat; topic_load_failed is the same idea per topic page.
fix: HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<Vec<ForumTopic>>>.

title: Contacts list is contacts: Option + contacts_error: bool
trigger: Invalidation sets contacts = None and error = false (apply.rs:256,273); a getContacts error sets contacts_error = true; success sets both.
effect: Idle, loading, ready and failed are inferred from two fields; a retry has no Loading stage, so a second failing fetch looks identical to the first.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: New contact box stage is new_contact_request + new_contact_outcome (+ contacts invalidation)
trigger: Create sends importContacts and records the id; the answer writes an outcome keyed by that id only if new_contact_request still equals it; closing the box clears the request.
effect: An outcome written for an open box that is closed before it reads it stays in new_contact_outcome until the next box; the invalidation of contacts runs even when the box is gone.
fix: enum NewContact { Closed, Sending{request}, Done{request,outcome} } owned by the box.

title: Three emoji-icon lists each carry a hand-kept *_failed bool; wearable_gifts_loaded conflates answered and failed
trigger: Errors set the *_failed flags (users/error.rs:46-71); connect/* and session_peer_color.rs reset them before a retry; payments/error.rs:132 sets wearable_gifts_loaded = true on a failure.
effect: A failed wearable-gifts request is indistinguishable from an empty list, so the colour editor shows no gifts and no retry hint.
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> / Fetch<Vec<ReceivedGift>>.

title: History retention stage is spread over closed_chats, release_chats, holds, dropped and the histories map
trigger: A chat moves between shown, queued for release, held, closed tail and dropped through retain/push_back calls in release_chat_history, settle_history_releases, touch_chat and drop_history_entry.
effect: Membership in five collections must stay consistent by hand (history_entry checks three of them before touching the LRU); no bug found, but each new creation path has to remember the same checks.
fix: A per-chat enum Retention { Shown, Releasing, Held, ClosedTail(rank), Dropped(memo) } in one map.

title: HistoryState window load stage is loaded_complete + newer_failed + load_failed + newer_exhausted kept in step by hand
trigger: Page far back, fail a newer page, reset the window, trim the window: each path clears a different subset (reset_window clears four, trim_window_end(Newest) clears only newer_failed, trim(Oldest) clears only loaded_complete).
effect: No bug today; every new path must remember which of the four flags it resets.
fix: One `WindowLoad { older: Fetch|Complete, newer: Idle|Failed|Exhausted{latest,newest}, first: Idle|Failed }` enum owned by the window and replaced by reset_window.

title: viewMessages bookkeeping is five collections plus a bool: viewed, viewing, visible, on_screen, visible_reported
trigger: An id moves visible -> viewing -> viewed by hand in begin_viewing/mark_viewed/commit_viewed/abort_viewing/reaction_unread; visible_reported switches which rule picks ids.
effect: See the viewing bug (same file, line 544); the stages of one id are not a value.
fix: `BTreeMap<i64, ViewStage>` with `ViewStage::{Due, InFlight(RequestId), Done}` and an enum for Unreported/Reported.

title: unread_anchor and opened_with_unread are two fields of one 'opened at unread' mode
trigger: Open a chat with unread messages; deleting the bar message clears unread_anchor but not opened_with_unread; jumping to latest clears both via end_unread_open; reset_window clears neither.
effect: No bug found; reset_window leaves a stale anchor by design.
fix: `enum OpenAt { Tail, Unread { anchor: MessageId, bar: Option<MessageId> } }`.

title: Main history window stage is load_failed, newer_failed, loaded_complete, newer_exhausted plus the in-flight requests and stale_history_requests
trigger: Open a chat, scroll, lose the network, jump around.
effect: history_loading(), history_load_failed() and history_has_newer() are derived from four bools/options on HistoryState and from the request registry; reset_window and trim clear them field by field, and a stale mark in stale_history_requests lives apart from the window it belongs to.
fix: A WindowEdge stage enum per edge (Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed, Complete) held by the window, so replacing the window drops its in-flight ids and stale marks with it.

title: MediaLibrary tracks a set's load stage in three collections: set_stickers, loading, failed
trigger: ensure_library_sets inserts into `loading` after the send; accept/fail move it to set_stickers/failed; open_media_panel and reconnect clear `failed`; creator.rs removes from `failed`.
effect: No stuck state found (lost requests settle through settle_lost_request), but four writers keep three sets consistent by hand, and the MAX_LIBRARY_LOADS cap counts `loading`.
fix: `HashMap<i64, SetLoad>` with `SetLoad::{Loading(RequestId), Ready(Vec<StickerItem>), Failed}`.

title: The reaction picker's options (MessageReactionsState) and payments.paid.offered change together by hand
trigger: accept_message_reaction_options sets both; reset_message_reactions clears both; fetch_message_reactions replaces only the first (Loading) and fail_message_reaction_options only the first.
effect: paid.offered can name message A while the state is for B (harmless today because paid_reaction.rs compares the message ids).
fix: Put `paid_offered: bool` inside MessageReactionOptions and drop payments.paid.offered.

title: ReplyTarget::Loading is written by the driver after the send, not by the request
trigger: connect/message_actions.rs:38 inserts Loading after send_json; accept and reject replace it; prune_reply_targets can evict it mid-flight.
effect: Entry and pending request are two records kept in step by the caller; an answer that is neither a message nor an error (settled request) leaves Loading forever.
fix: Register the target as Loading{request} and drop it when the request is settled (lost-request path).

title: PendingRequest correlates answers through ~12 optional key fields where the purpose decides which one is read
fix: Move the key into the purpose variant (a typed key per purpose).

title: RequestRegistry.window is ambient state that must follow the swapped SessionView (enter_view / with_view / apply_payload_in_asking_view)
fix: Pass the window as an argument to register, or hold the view and its window as one value.

title: PendingBotMessage stop_failed + stopped + can_stop + keep_on_stop
fix: Stop stage enum Running | Stopping | Stopped | StopFailed.

title: open_chat + open_topic (+ threads.thread, saved views) are reset together by open_chat and leave_open_chat
fix: One OpenView enum: None | Chat{id, topic: TopicList|Topic|Thread|Saved}.

title: PendingBotMessage stage is four hand-synced fields (can_stop, keep_on_stop, stopped, stop_failed)
trigger: Stop a streaming bot reply: finish_pending_bot_stop sets can_stop=false, stopped=true, stop_failed=false by hand; the error arm sets stop_failed elsewhere.
effect: No bug today; a stop that fails after stopped could leave contradictory flags.
fix: enum BotDraftStage { Streaming{can_stop}, Stopping, Stopped, StopFailed } with keep_on_stop as a constant of the draft.

title: Boost-unrestrict value in flight is a map beside the request table
trigger: Move the slider and save: unrestrict_boost_pending holds the value while RequestPurpose::SetSupergroupUnrestrictBoostCount is in flight; ok moves it to the full info, error removes it. A second change while one is in flight is silently dropped (has_purpose_for_chat).
effect: The slider shows the first value while the second change is lost without a note.
fix: Save state per chat as enum { Idle, Saving{request,value} } in the supergroup info.

title: Group-call join state is need_rejoin + rejoin + is_joined + left_group_call kept in step by apply_group_call_fields
trigger: Network drop makes TDLib send need_rejoin; a join answer, a joined update or a leave each change a different subset of these fields.
effect: No bug found; the comments describe order dependencies (a routine joined update is no evidence of a rejoin).
fix: One GroupCallLink enum { NotJoined, Joining, Joined, Rejoining{request}, Left } on the call.

title: Forward progress is in_flight_forward, queued_forward_flights and a one-slot last_forward
trigger: Forward to several destinations from the share box.
effect: A flight lives in one of two places (the Option or the Vec) and finish_forward finds it by trying both; its result goes to a single Option that the poll takes, so two answers in one ingest batch overwrite each other and the first destination's note is lost (S4).
fix: One Vec<ForwardFlight { extra, stage: Queued|Sent }> and a results queue (Vec<ForwardResult>) drained by the UI.

title: MessageReportFlow keeps trail and previous as parallel vectors beside stage
trigger: Walk the report through sub-reasons and press Back.
effect: message_report_sending pushes to trail and previous together and message_report_back pops both; a path that pushes only one would misalign the breadcrumb and the Back target. Sending/Checking have no request id, so no way to tell which request they wait for.
fix: A single Vec<ReportStep { chosen_text, title, options }> and stage variants Checking(RequestId) / Sending(RequestId).

title: MessageAudience tabs keep Audience stage per list plus a separate more_loading set
trigger: Open the reactions dialog, switch tabs, press Load more.
effect: A tab that is Ready and also in more_loading is two facts about one list held in two collections; fail and accept must remove the key by hand in each arm.
fix: Audience::Ready { value, more: Idle|Loading } so the next page is part of the tab's stage.

title: StickerSetView has files_requested: bool and edits flags (refresh_needed, busy) beside its stage enum
trigger: Open View Sticker Set, edit an owned set while the set refetches.
effect: Whether files were asked for and whether a refetch is owed are separate flags that must follow stage by hand (accept_sticker_set_view sets refresh_needed from busy(); a Failed refetch leaves it).
fix: Move files_requested into StickerSetViewStage::Ready { files: FilesAsked } and make the refetch a stage (Ready { refreshing }).

title: Story card state is derived from three sets (stories, missing, reply_attempted) plus story_retry
trigger: story_card_state returns Loading when the story is in neither stories nor missing; candidates are filtered by reply_attempted; failures edit story_retry and reply_attempted by hand (story_fetch_failed).
effect: Loading is 'absence', so a story whose fetch was never started and one whose fetch failed look the same.
fix: HashMap<(i64,i32), StoryFetch{Loading(request), Ready, Gone, Retry{at}}>.

title: Call privacy loading is a u8 counter next to an error bool
trigger: fetch_call_privacy and set_call_privacy increment privacy_pending; apply_ok, apply and the error arm decrement via privacy_roundtrip_done; send failures zero it.
effect: A dropped continuation (stale generation) never decrements, leaving the pending state set.
fix: Per-rule Fetch<PrivacyWho> enum values; derive pending/error from them.

title: Notification delivery state is pending_notifications, shown_notification_chats and pending_notification_clears kept in step
trigger: queue_notification_with_sound inserts into shown before the UI shows anything; clear_chat_notifications removes from shown and queues a clear if it was there.
effect: A notification dropped from the queue before it was shown still queues a clear (harmless withdraw of nothing); the three sets are written by hand in both places.
fix: Per-chat enum NotifyState { Queued, Shown, ClearDue } in one map.

title: Emoji icon lists are Vec + *_failed bool with 'empty' standing for 'not loaded'
trigger: load_*_emoji_icons refetches whenever the list is empty or failed; accept_* sets failed=false.
effect: A successful empty answer is indistinguishable from not asked, so every open of the dialog asks again.
fix: Three Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> fields.
